items.title: Cal Collins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 11, 1997
items.q: His career has included gigs with Benny Goodman, Warren Vache and Scott Hamilton.

ctx.x: Nobby Totah, T-O-T-A-H, he used to play quite a bit with Johnny Smith, on some of his old recordings, Royal Roost I think it was, and that was about it. Let’s see, Warren Vache, he was on, and later on Scott Hamilton played quite a bit. It was a good quintet, very good.
Now in that kind of situation, did he have music for you?
